accepted_blueprint_role.advances_plan: The Arisen is the centrepiece planeswalker and Ravager's ETB gives discard.
accepted_blueprint_role.honest_note: All three Spellbook infinites (Teferi + Chain Veil, Teferi + Ichormoon Gauntlet + Chain Veil or Rowan's Talent) are commander-free. Bolas's transform costs seven mana at sorcery speed. He is the deck's best planeswalker rather than its engine, and a superfriends shell would work under another Grixis walker commander. The cycle 51 M1 review (bolasrav-01..08, all verified) confirms the transform and loyalty rules.

limitations: Exact-name/Blueprint support is structural evidence, not a complete rules-interaction detector.
A route without an explicit commander reference may still gain substantial value from the commander in play.
A route with an explicit commander reference may have redundant alternate routes not captured by a single Blueprint field.
